message:
Command `printf '%s
' '--- env names ---'; env | sed 's/=.*//' | sort | grep -E '^(DATABASE|VENDOR|NOTICE|INSURANCE|STRIPE|BASE_URL|PORT)'; printf '%s
' '--- deps ---'; find /opt/gearvault-deps/node_modules -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d -printf '%f
' | sort | head -80; printf '%s
' '--- vendor package ---'; find /opt/gearvault-shop -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p
' 2>/dev/null | head -80; printf '%s
' '--- services ---'; curl -sS --max-time 3 ${VENDOR_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3101}/health || true; echo; curl -sS --max-time 3 ${VENDOR_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3101}/ || true` executed with exit code 0.
